item.description:
Frank Sinatra - The Collection 1953-1962 [Vinyl, 16LPs MFSL Box Set] (1983) DSD 128



Officially lmited to 25,000 copies, but around 10,000 copies were made. Comes with Geo Disc.
Pressed in Japan.
Released in October, 1983.
Translucent vinyl due to usage of "super vinyl" formula
There is also a rarer variation of this box set with black and white album jackets and black coloured plate with the number of the issue. These issues are assumed to have numbers close to 10000.
